name: Blogy AI CMO
author: reverblunt

sections.description:
Blogy is an AI growth engine that researches your business, plans an SEO content roadmap, and publishes articles to your WordPress blog automatically.

This plugin links your WordPress site to your Blogy workspace using WordPress’ built-in Application Passwords, so you never have to generate, copy, or paste credentials by hand.

Features

  • One-click connect — no API keys.
  • Optional pairing-code linking for fully in-dashboard setup.
  • Uses native WordPress Application Passwords (revocable any time).
  • Publishes posts and featured images through the standard REST API.

A Blogy account is required. Publishing and content generation happen in the Blogy app (https://blogy.in).

External services

This plugin connects to the Blogy API (https://api.blogy.in) to link your site and receive published content. Your site URL, the WordPress username used for publishing, and an Application Password are sent to Blogy so it can publish on your behalf. See https://blogy.in/privacy for details.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Blogy.
  3. Click Connect to Blogy (or paste a pairing code from your Blogy dashboard).
  4. Approve the connection. That’s it — Blogy will start publishing.
sections.faq:
Do I need to paste any API keys?

No. The plugin uses WordPress Application Passwords behind the scenes; you only click Connect.

How do I revoke access?

Go to Users → Profile → Application Passwords and revoke the “Blogy” entry, or click Disconnect on the Blogy settings page.

Is HTTPS required?

Yes. WordPress Application Passwords require your site to be served over HTTPS.
